title: hub-enrolment v1
description: The hub's register of one enrolled node (remote plan R13b and R17: 'registry entries written by horde hub enroll'), one file per device under <HordeHome>/hub/nodes/<deviceId>.json, written by `horde hub enroll` and `horde hub revoke` (cli/HubRegistry.ps1) and by nothing else. It is the hub's own record of whom it admitted, kept apart from the transport's own file of admitted keys so that each checks the other: the listener serves a key line only for a device this register holds, live, with that same key, and the hub binds a dialled link only to such a device. transport is the transport whose enrolment admitted the key; key is that transport's public key line for the device, as the transport wrote it (its type word and base64); expires is the last day the enrolment is not yet over, YYYYMMDD, as the transport's own expiry (the key is refused from 00:00 of that day, local time). address, when present, is the node's last-known address on the private network it reaches the hub by, given at enrolment (`horde hub enroll -Address`): `horde listen` on a network address lets nodes in through its firewall rule from these addresses alone (core/FirewallPort.ps1), and a renewal that names none keeps it. revokedAt is present once the device is revoked, and the entry is then never live again; enrolling the device again with a new key writes a fresh entry without it. A file that fails this schema is unknown, never a guessed enrolment.
